verdict.rationale: Oyster's API documents a client credentials authorization flow for internal integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows scopes, permission restriction or least-privilege credentials that could be issued to an agent. Issuing a credential at all is adjacent to the story, not the scoped capability it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Client credentials can be used when building an integration for internal company use or for certain partner use cases
